description: This Java class 'NoteRequest' serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling request payloads related to creating or updating notes. It includes validation annotations to ensure proper data constraints on 'title' and 'content'.

classes.name: NoteRequest
classes.description: A DTO class representing a request to create or update a note, with validation rules for 'title' and 'content'.
